considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to the front of the residence. The front of the property is open and offers space for emergency vehicle staging. Fencing encloses much of the rear yard. The large open backyard provides additional space for movement and staging. Multiple detached structures and an above-ground pool are present in the rear. Neighboring homes are close in this residential setting.
